ai.title: Fix usage limit warning copy in client.ts
ai.summary: Updated the monthly usage limit warning message in `npm-app/src/client.ts` to read "over ${pct}%" instead of "${pct}+%". This corrects the phrasing for clarity when users approach their quota. The change is internal to the CLI client's console output logic.

eli5.text: When you log in and run commands, the assistant checks how much of your monthly usage limit you've used. If you're close to the limit, it prints a yellow warning saying how much you've used so far. The wording of that warning was slightly off, it said "You have used 80+% of your monthly usage limit" instead of "You have used over 80% of your monthly usage limit." That's fixed now, so the message reads more naturally if you see it in your terminal. Only the text of the message changed, not when or how often it appears.
